rule.name: CredentialLiteral
rule.message: Read it from the environment or a secrets manager: this string looks like a credential (access key, token, private key, or a password in a URL).
rule.description: A string literal shaped like an access key, a token, a private key or a URL with a password.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $candidate := function($v) { not(matches($v, '\s')) and not(matches($v, '^(?:\*+\w{0,4}|x+|<.*>|\[.*\]|\$\{.*\}|\$[a-z_]\w*|\{\{.*\}\}|\{\w*\}|%s|%\(\w+\)s|:[a-z_]+|changeme|change-me|todo|example|dummy|placeholder|redacted|none|null|undefined|your[-_ ].*)$', 'i')) and not(matches($v, '^(?:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+|[A-Za-z]+(?:[._:/-][A-Za-z]+)+|[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(?:[./][a-z0-9_-]+)+|(?:~|\.{1,2})?(?:/[\w.-]+)+/?|\^.*\$|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(?:T[\d:.]+(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?)?)$')) }, $looksSecret := function($v) { string-length($v) >= 6 and $candidate($v) and ((matches($v, '\d') and matches($v, '[A-Za-z]')) or count((matches($v, '[a-z]'), matches($v, '[A-Z]'), matches($v, '\d'), matches($v, '[^A-Za-z0-9]'))[.]) >= 3) }, $shape := function($v) { matches($v, '(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(?:AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|[rs]k_(?:live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-(?:proj|ant|live|test)-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|django-insecure-\S{6,})') or matches($v, '-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----') or (matches($v, '^(?:jdbc:)?[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s/:@]+:[^\s/@]+@', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^(?:jdbc:)?[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s/:@]+:([^\s/@]+)@.*$', '$1', 'is'))) or (matches($v, '^(?:bearer|basic|token)\s+\S+$', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^\S+\s+(\S+)$', '$1', 'i'))) or (matches($v, '[?&;]password=[^&;\s]+', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^.*[?&;]password=([^&;\s]+).*$', '$1', 'is'))) } return //StringLiteral[$shape(@ConstValue)]
